name: Science Corporation (neurotech)
desc: Neural engineering company developing brain-computer interfaces and the PRIMA light-powered retinal implant for macular degeneration patients.
ownership: private, owner not stated (venture-backed: Khosla Ventures, Y Combinator and others)
capacity_detail: Raised USD 400M Series D (17 Nov 2026, led by Khosla Ventures); total funding over USD 900M since 2021
markets: PRIMA retinal implant being made more widely available in Europe, with preparation for United States market entry.

signals.raise: USD 400M Series D led by Khosla Ventures (Nov 2026; https://news.crunchbase.com/venture/biggest-startup-rounds-science-neurotech-model-ml-galvanize-therapeutics/)
signals.regions: Preparing US market entry for PRIMA implant after Europe (Nov 2026; https://app.fundz.net/fundings/science-corporation-funding-round-series-d-a882b2)

rationale: Well-funded medtech moving from Europe to US launch; F1's precision-engineering story suits a high-tech brand-building and investor-visibility push.

name: ICON (3D-printed construction)
desc: Austin company making robotic 3D printing systems that build residential and commercial buildings, including its multi-story Titan system.
ownership: private, owner not stated (venture-backed: Baillie Gifford, BlackRock funds)
capacity_detail: USD 200M Series D (13 Oct 2026) at a USD 1.4B valuation; total capital raised USD 700M
markets: United States construction, with planned expansion in Texas, Florida and Washington, D.C.

signals.raise: USD 200M Series D at USD 1.4B valuation, Baillie Gifford and BlackRock funds (Oct 2026; https://app.fundz.net/fundings/icon-funding-round-series-d-3882d4)

rationale: Robotics-led construction brand; F1's engineering showcase and US races (Austin's COTA) could amplify its technology story to developers and investors.

name: Marrow Therapeutics
desc: Genetic medicines company developing antibody conjugates that deliver therapies to bone marrow for sickle cell and thalassemia.
ownership: private, owner not stated (venture-backed: OrbiMed, Scion Life Sciences, venBio, KKR and others)
capacity_detail: Launched with USD 173M equity: USD 53M Series A plus USD 120M Series B led by OrbiMed (17 Nov 2026)
markets: Pre-clinical drug developer in the United States; lead candidate MAR-101 is in IND-enabling studies.

signals.raise: USD 120M Series B led by OrbiMed, USD 173M in total (Nov 2026; https://www.marrowtx.com/news/marrow-therapeutics-launches-with-173-million-to-develop-genetic-medicines-for-bone-marrow-disorders/)

rationale: Pre-clinical biotech with no consumer brand; F1 hospitality might serve investor relations at most, so a sponsorship is very unlikely.

name: Databento
desc: Financial market data platform offering self-service real-time and historical market data across asset classes, founded in 2019.
ownership: private, owner not stated (venture-backed: Fifth Down Capital, NEA, DRW Venture Capital and others)
capacity_detail: USD 100M Series C led by Fifth Down Capital (12 Nov 2026) at a USD 1.1B valuation
markets: Market data for trading firms and developers, covering multiple asset classes; customer geography not stated.

signals.raise: USD 100M Series C at USD 1.1B valuation led by Fifth Down Capital (Nov 2026; https://app.fundz.net/fundings/databento-funding-round-series-c-608008)

rationale: New unicorn selling to trading firms; F1's data-driven image and hospitality suit B2B client entertainment, though it is still small.
